extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF source. Mechanism claims are separated from activity rows and avoid overclaiming BGC/computational context as direct wet-lab mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peoriaerin IBSD35 has source-supported structural context consistent with membrane embedding, based on the article's predicted 3-D model and residue-property caption.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational/model context only; not promoted to direct wet-lab membrane mechanism by itself.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM/mode-of-action observations support cellular penetration/periplasm-cytoplasm effect against S. aureus at 1x MIC, with no DNA/protein leakage evidence reported.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Peoriaerin IBSD35 against Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 25923
mechanism_claims.limitations: Directly supports morphology/cell-penetration context, not a resolved molecular target or pore-formation mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Genome mining supports biosynthetic potential for antimicrobial secondary metabolites, including NRPS/lantipeptide/lassopeptide/bacteriocin clusters, but these are production-context evidence rather than direct mechanism assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Paenibacillus peoriae IBSD35 antimicrobial metabolite potential
mechanism_claims.limitations: BGC annotations are not activity endpoints and are not treated as direct mechanism claims.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary source supports SEM morphology and no DNA/protein leakage but does not identify a precise molecular target.
